title: Ray callback bidirectional filter
summary: Recovered 0x4270e0 as a genuine thiscall member: accept when proxy group at +4 intersects callback mask at +14 and proxy mask at +6 intersects callback group at +12. Short circuits on first rejection; returns bool in AL and writes no memory. Two vtable entries reference it; no direct calls found.
test_description: Direct original thiscall comparison: 4096 boundary-mask combinations, 1024 single-bit/complement cases, and 10000 deterministic mixed-mask cases. Checks independent predicate, Boolean result, complete observed prefixes and trailing canaries unchanged by both calls, and FS head restoration after each original call. Initialized test FS setup must succeed.
known_limits: Original class names, complete object sizes and virtual dispatch callers are unresolved; layouts describe observed prefixes only.
Requires valid readable objects; null/dangling pointers and fault ordering on inaccessible storage are not exercised.
No byte matching claim; only AL is defined as the Boolean return.
